title: Federated learning model lineage

pse.problem: Limitation in tracking and recording updates during federated learning, making it difficult to trace the evolution of machine learning models
pse.solution_function: A system records initial models and their updates from workers during a round of training in a federated learning system, creating a lineage database for each model
pse.solution_structure: The system consists of a model lineage system (aggregator) that receives and records initial models and updates from workers, and a lineage database to store the recorded data
pse.solution_implementation: Upon starting a round of training by an aggregator in the federated learning system, the initial model is dispatched to workers. The workers train the model locally and send their updates back to the aggregator, which records them in the lineage database.
pse.effect: Enables tracking and tracing the evolution of machine learning models during federated learning, providing accountability and reproducibility for future use or analysis
